passage: Maharashtra is a state in the western peninsular region of India occupying a substantial portion of the Deccan Plateau. Mumbai is the capital of Maharashtra and is also the financial capital of India. The state was formed on 1 May 1960 when the former Bombay State was split into the two new states of Maharashtra and Gujarat.

The Ganga is the longest river in India, with a total length of approximately 2,525 kilometres. It originates from the Gangotri Glacier in the Himalayas and flows through the states of Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and West Bengal before emptying into the Bay of Bengal.
गंगा नदी भारत की सबसे लंबी नदी है जिसकी कुल लंबाई लगभग 2,525 किलोमीटर है। यह उत्तराखंड के गंगोत्री ग्लेशियर से निकलती है और उत्तर प्रदेश, बिहार और पश्चिम बंगाल से होकर बहती है।

The national flower of Bangladesh is the White Water Lily, known locally as Shapla (শাপলা). It is an aquatic plant that grows in the ponds and rivers of Bangladesh and holds deep cultural significance for the nation.
বাংলাদেশের জাতীয় ফুল শাপলা (সাদা পদ্ম)। এটি একটি জলজ উদ্ভিদ যা বাংলাদেশের পুকুর ও নদীতে জন্মায় এবং দেশের সাংস্কৃতিক পরিচয়ের একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অংশ।

Chennai is the capital of the state of Tamil Nadu in India. It is located on the Coromandel Coast of the Bay of Bengal. Chennai is known as the 'Gateway to South India' and is a major cultural, economic, and educational centre of South Asia.
தமிழ்நாட்டின் தலைநகரம் சென்னை ஆகும். இது இந்தியாவின் தென்கிழக்கு கடற்கரையில் பங்காள விரிகுடாவில் அமைந்துள்ளது. சென்னை தென்னிந்தியாவின் நுழைவாயில் என்று அழைக்கப்படுகிறது.

The Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture combines information retrieval with language generation. A retriever first fetches relevant documents from a knowledge base, and a generator then produces an answer grounded in the retrieved context, reducing hallucinations.

BM25 is a probabilistic retrieval model that scores documents based on the frequency of query terms in each document, adjusted for document length. The two key parameters are k1 (term saturation, typically 1.2–2.0) and b (length normalization, typically 0.75).

Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) is a method for combining rankings from multiple retrieval systems. Given a constant k (typically 60), each document's score is the sum of 1/(k + rank) across all lists. This is robust to score distribution differences between systems.

MSMARCO-XI is a multilingual information retrieval dataset created by AI4Bharat. It extends the Microsoft MSMARCO dataset to cover 11 languages including English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, and Oriya.
भारत की राजधानी नई दिल्ली है। यह उत्तरी भारत में यमुना नदी के किनारे स्थित है। दिल्ली देश का सबसे बड़ा शहर है और यहाँ भारत सरकार के सभी प्रमुख कार्यालय हैं।

Hyderabad is the capital of Telangana and serves as the de facto capital of Andhra Pradesh. The city is known as the 'City of Pearls' and is a major technology hub home to companies like Microsoft, Google, Amazon, and many Indian IT firms.
హైదరాబాద్ తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్ర రాజధాని. ఇది 'ముత్యాల నగరం' అని పిలువబడుతుంది మరియు భారతదేశంలోని ప్రధాన సాంకేతిక కేంద్రాలలో ఒకటి.

Random indexing is a dimensionality reduction technique based on the Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma. Instead of computing a full term-by-term matrix, each term is assigned a sparse random signature vector. The embedding of a term is the weighted sum of its co-occurring terms' signatures.

Positive Pointwise Mutual Information (PPMI) measures how much more often two words co-occur than by chance. PPMI(w, c) = max(0, log(P(w,c) / P(w)P(c))). Context-distribution smoothing, raising context marginals to the power alpha=0.75, reduces the inflation of PMI for rare contexts.

Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) is an algorithm for selecting diverse and relevant documents. It iteratively selects the document that maximizes a linear combination of relevance to the query and dissimilarity to already-selected documents, controlled by parameter lambda.

India is a country in South Asia with the world's largest population. It is officially the Republic of India and is the seventh-largest country by area. The country has 28 states and 8 union territories, each with its own culture and language.
मुंबई भारत की वित्तीय राजधानी है और महाराष्ट्र राज्य की राजधानी भी है। यह भारत का सबसे बड़ा शहर है और यहाँ भारतीय सिनेमा, जिसे बॉलीवुड कहते हैं, का केंद्र है।

The Western Ghats, also known as Sahyadri, is a mountain range along the western coast of India. It is one of the world's eight hotspots of biological diversity and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The range runs parallel to the western coast for about 1,600 km.

Sentence window chunking is a retrieval technique where individual sentences are indexed for matching but a window of surrounding sentences is used for answer generation. This gives precise matching precision with sufficient context for generation.

Hierarchical chunking, or small-to-big retrieval, indexes small child chunks for precise matching but retrieves the larger parent chunks for generation context. This balances retrieval precision with generation context richness.

IVF (Inverted File Index) is an approximate nearest neighbour search method. The vector space is partitioned into clusters using k-means. At query time, only the nearest nprobe clusters are searched, reducing computation from O(N) to O(sqrt(N)).
ਪੰਜਾਬ ਭਾਰਤ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਰਾਜ ਹੈ। ਇਸਦੀ ਰਾਜਧਾਨੀ ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ ਹੈ। ਪੰਜਾਬ ਨੂੰ 'ਭਾਰਤ ਦੀ ਰੋਟੀ ਦੀ ਟੋਕਰੀ' ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਇਹ ਕਣਕ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਮੁੱਖ ਉਤਪਾਦਕ ਰਾਜ ਹੈ।

Kerala is a state on the southwestern Malabar Coast of India. It is known for its palm-lined beaches, backwaters, and Ayurvedic tourism. Thiruvananthapuram is the capital of Kerala. The state has the highest literacy rate in India at over 96%.
കേരളത്തിന്റെ തലസ്ഥാനം തിരുവനന്തപുരം ആണ്. കേരളം അതിന്റെ ഹൗസ്ബോട്ടുകൾ, ആയൂർവേദ ചികിത്സ, ഉയർന്ന സാക്ഷരതാ നിരക്ക് എന്നിവയ്ക്ക് പ്രസിദ്ധമാണ്.

Guardrails in AI systems are safety checks that prevent harmful, misleading, or off-topic outputs. An input guardrail checks the user's query for unsafe content, PII, and prompt injection. An output guardrail checks the generated answer for grounding and factual consistency.

Proposition chunking decomposes a passage into atomic, self-contained factual statements. Each proposition is indexed independently, enabling very precise retrieval. The challenge is that a good proposition chunker requires language understanding to decompose complex sentences.

Rajasthan is the largest state in India by area. Jaipur is its capital, known as the Pink City. The state is known for its Thar Desert, historic forts, palaces, and colourful culture. Major attractions include the Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, and the city of Udaipur.
